form.label: BigFix Insights: ETL Sync Monitoring
form.description: Monitors data churn, parallel extraction performance, and sequence tracking for BigFix Insights database imports.

search.query: index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:webui:insights" $idx_earliest$ $idx_latest$ "Number of extraction tasks processed in parallel" | rex "Number of extraction tasks processed in parallel:\s+(?<Parallel_Tasks>\d+)" | stats max(Parallel_Tasks) AS Max_Tasks
index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:webui:insights" $idx_earliest$ $idx_latest$ "Number of rows for" | rex "Number of rows for \"(?<Entity>[^\"]+)\":" | stats dc(Entity) AS Total_Entities

index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:webui:insights" $idx_earliest$ $idx_latest$ "Number of rows for" | rex "Number of rows for \"(?<Entity>[^\"]+)\": (?<Row_Count>\d+)" | search Row_Count > 0 | eval "Item Type"=case( Entity=="DatasourceAction", "Actions", Entity=="DatasourceFixlet", "Fixlets", Entity=="DatasourceDevice", "Computers / Devices", Entity=="DatasourceUser", "Users", Entity=="DatasourceRole", "Roles", Entity=="DatasourceSite", "Sites", Entity=="DatasourceGroup", "Groups", Entity=="DatasourceAnalysis", "Analyses", Entity=="DatasourceActionResult", "Action Results", Entity=="DatasourcePropertyResult", "Property Results", Entity=="StagingFixletField", "Fixlet Fields", Entity=="StagingFixletResult", "Fixlet Results", true(), Entity ) | stats sum(Row_Count) AS "Total Items Synced", latest(_time) AS "Last Synced" by "Item Type" | fieldformat "Last Synced" = strftime('Last Synced', "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - "Total Items Synced"

index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:webui:insights" $idx_earliest$ $idx_latest$ "Number of rows for" | rex "Number of rows for \"(?<Entity>[^\"]+)\": (?<Row_Count>\d+)" | search Row_Count > 0 | stats sum(Row_Count) AS "Total Rows Synced" by Entity | sort - "Total Rows Synced"

index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:webui:insights" $idx_earliest$ $idx_latest$ "Updating sequence for datasource:" | rex "entity:\s+(?<Entity>\S+)" | rex "last_sequence\s*=\s*(?<Last_Sequence>0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)" | stats latest(_time) AS _time, latest(Last_Sequence) AS "Last Synced Sequence" by Entity | sort Entity | table Entity, "Last Synced Sequence", _time

index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:webui:insights" $idx_earliest$ $idx_latest$ "cleanup query for entity" | rex "cleanup query for entity \"(?<Entity>[^\"]+)\":" | stats count AS "Cleanup Operations Triggered", latest(_time) AS "Last Cleanup Executed" by Entity | sort - "Last Cleanup Executed"
